Title: Impala
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/databasespecific/overview-4
Content: Apache Impala is a SQL query engine that sits on top of Apache Hadoop. The JDBC connector can connect to an Impala database to pull structure and lineage metadata. To leverage these capabilities, solidatus.jdbc.driver must be set to impala. For SQL parsing related features solidatus.jdbc.dialect must be set to impala.

Title: Permissions
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/databasespecific/overview-4/permissions
Content: Authorization determines which users are allowed to access which resources, and what operations they are allowed to perform. Apache Ranger can be used for authorization. By default, when authorization is not enabled, Impala does all read and write operations with the privileges of the impala user.
